note: The city hubs: the entries of the City filter, each with a page of its own. A company joins every hub whose words appear anywhere in its operating location, office address or headquarters (lowercase containment, as in the upstream pipeline). A conditional word counts only when none of its unless words appear. A company that joins no hub is in the rest hub. cities are the city ids (from city-centroids.json) the hub stands for, first one first; the site uses them for the map, the city tiles and which office a row shows. Adding a hub here gives it a filter entry, a page and a tile at the next build, with no code change; a company is re-sorted at the next npm run data.
